patterns.name: Backoff cap asserted after jitter, not before
patterns.description: In src/lib/payment-retry.ts, calculateBackoffDelay caps the exponential delay at maxDelayMs and THEN adds up to 50% jitter, so the returned delay can exceed maxDelayMs by half again (10000 becomes up to 15000). A property test must assert the post-jitter bound, or it will pass while the stated contract is broken.

patterns.name: Retry loop carries no idempotency key
patterns.description: processPaymentWithRetry in src/lib/payment-retry.ts re-invokes the gateway with the same PaymentRequest after a timeout or network error. PaymentRequest has no idempotency key, so a gateway that succeeded but failed to respond will be charged again on retry. Treat this as the highest-risk element of the checkout product, and assert that the same logical payment cannot settle twice.

template.content: Check whether {{module}} can settle the same logical payment twice. Look for an idempotency key on the request, a dedupe store keyed by order id, or a gateway contract that guarantees it. Report the gap and the test that would catch it.

patterns.name: Exhausted-retry path reports a fixed attempt count
patterns.description: On the exhausted path, processPaymentWithRetry returns attempts: config.maxRetries + 1 as a constant rather than the number of gateway calls actually made. Assert attempts against a call-count spy on the gateway, not against the returned field, or the test will agree with the bug.

patterns.name: Cart state layer is the largest untested surface
patterns.description: aqe hg untested on this repo reports cartReducer, CartProvider and useCart in src/context/CartContext.tsx with no covering test, and aqe code complexity scores that file at cyclomatic 9 and cognitive 17, the highest in src/. Untested plus most branched is where coverage work pays first. Drive the reducer through its action union rather than testing the provider through the UI.

template.content:
1. Enumerate every action type handled by {{reducer}}
2. Assert the state transition for each, including the unknown-action default
3. Assert quantity and total arithmetic at the boundaries: zero, one, removal of the last line
4. Only then test {{provider}} through the hook

patterns.name: Checkout errors are announced but not associated with their field
patterns.description: In src/components/CheckoutForm.tsx every validation error already renders with role="alert", so screen readers do announce it. The gap is the association: the inputs carry no aria-describedby pointing at their error element, and the source marks this at the gdprConsent field with a "QUALITY GAP: Missing aria-describedby for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance" comment. An accessibility assessment that reports "errors are not announced" is wrong about this code.

patterns.name: Request validation checks shape rather than meaning
patterns.description: validatePaymentRequest accepts any three-character currency, so 'ZZZ' and '123' pass. Luhn validation in src/lib/luhn.ts likewise proves a number is well formed, not that it is a real card. When an acceptance criterion says valid, ask which of the two it means; that ambiguity is the kind of requirements gap the ideation gate is meant to catch before code.

template.content: For every use of the word valid in {{artifact}}, state whether it means well formed or genuine, and name the test that distinguishes them.
